core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hannah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Joy, happiness”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hannah corresponds to the Arabic form هناء (Arabic root ه ن أ (h-n-ʾ); هَنَاء (Hanāʾ)). Its core sense is joy, happiness, gladness. Hannah is treated here as a transliteration of Arabic هَنَاء (Hanāʾ) 'joy, happiness', from the root ه ن أ (h-n-ʾ). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave عائشة (ʿĀʾisha) as the Arabic form, which is a completely different name, and its Hindi column gave औँचह, which is not a word. Note that the English name Hannah is a separate Hebrew name (חַנָּה, 'grace/favour') and must not be merged with the Arabic form. Recorded at medium confidence because the Latin spelling is shared by two distinct names.
